🚀 From Documents to Decisions: Reimagining Intelligent Document Processing with GenAI

📄 How can Generative AI take document processing beyond simple data extraction to drive smarter business decisions? 🧠

🎤 Join Aiham Taleb, Nikita Kozodoi, PhD, and me at AWS Deep Dive Days – Generative AI!

💡 We'll explore how multimodal AI is transforming Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and what it takes to bring these solutions from prototype to production. ⚙️

📅 November 5, 2026
⏰ 13:30–14:15 CET
📍 AWS Munich (MUC14)

🔗 Event details: https://lnkd.in/eFB-VhyS

🙌 Looking forward to seeing you there!
#GenerativeAI #AWS #IntelligentDocumentProcessing #MultimodalAI

Happy to be in Budapest for EMNLP 2026! 🇭🇺

Tomorrow I'm presenting our joint work from the collaboration between AUMOVIO and the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Generative AI Innovation Center at the REALM workshop: the journey of building an engineering assistant for automotive software, and the tooling behind it. It has been a great collaboration, and I'm really looking forward to sharing it with the research community.

Thank you to my co-authors Aiham Taleb, Nikita Kozodoi, PhD, Daniel Schleicher, Amir Mahdi Namazi, Martin Kraus, Levent Kent and Brian Jensen.

If you're in Budapest and would like to chat about automotive, agentic systems, time series or anything else, let me know or come find me at our poster. Always happy to meet!  😊 

Paper: https://lnkd.in/d3_gRhCd 
Workshop: https://lnkd.in/dvRykybn
